subject: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental evidence request for contract review
messages:
From: Alice Bowman <alice.bowman@mercyhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: MercyHealth Procurement <procurement@mercyhealth.com>, MercyHealth Security <security@mercyhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II and supplemental artifacts for procurement review

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and our security team are kicking off the contract review and need to collect the following items to complete our vendor risk process (JIRA PROC-4721):

- SOC 2 Type II report for the period covering Jan 1, 2025 – Dec 31, 2025. If your report period does not overlap our coverage window, please also provide a bridge letter that attests to changes since the report date.
- Targeted control evidence beyond the SOC report: MFA enforcement policy + a sample of MFA rotation/activation logs for April 1–30, 2026 (we accept hashed user IDs), privileged access review outputs for the last 6 months, and keystore rotation entries (timestamps + KMS/ARN references).
- Scoped authn/authz log slices for the window Apr 1–30, 2026 showing successful/failed interactive logins and token refresh events (PII can be redacted).

Can you confirm you can provide these artifacts and if you require an NDA before we share the signed SOC 2 in full? Our target for receiving artifacts is COB 2026-06-03 to keep the procurement timeline intact.

Appreciate a quick confirmation and any anticipated exceptions.

Best,
Alice Bowman
Senior InfoSec Analyst, MercyHealth
alice.bowman@mercyhealth.com

Attachments: MercyHealth_Vendor_Checklist_PROC-4721.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Bowman <alice.bowman@mercyhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and supplemental artifacts for procurement review

Alice —

Thanks for the clear list and timeline. We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and the supplemental artifacts you requested. High-level plan:

1) SOC 2 Type II (redacted): we will send a redacted copy for procurement review and coordinate NDA delivery if you need the unredacted signed report.
2) Bridge letter: if the report period doesn’t fully cover your audit window, we will attach a short bridge letter summarizing control continuity and any changes since the report date.
3) Targeted artifacts: MFA activation/rotation sample (CSV with hashed user IDs), privileged access review summary (PDF), keystore rotation log entries (CSV), and scoped authn log slices for Apr 1–30, 2026 (CSV).

Proposed timeline: SOC 2 redacted + bridge (if required) by 2026-05-27; scoped log slices and control artifacts by 2026-06-02 to meet your 2026-06-03 deadline.

Questions: Do you require any specific format for the authn log slices (columns/fields)? Do you prefer hashed user IDs salted by MercyHealth or is a Redwood-generated hash acceptable?

I’m cc’ing Karthik and Laura to coordinate extraction and redaction. We’ll produce an evidence matrix so you can track what’s delivered.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood_soc2_type_ii_2025_redacted.pdf (pdf)
From: Alice Bowman <alice.bowman@mercyhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: MercyHealth Procurement <procurement@mercyhealth.com>, MercyHealth Security <security@mercyhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and supplemental artifacts for procurement review

Jonas —

That timeline works for us. A few clarifications:

- Authn log slices: please include timestamp, event_type (interactive_login, token_refresh), outcome (success/failure), source_ip, user_id (hashed). CSV is fine.
- For hashed user IDs, MercyHealth prefers HMAC-SHA256 with the salt we will provide (we can share via the NDA link). If that’s not possible, please clearly document the hashing approach.
- We will need the keystore rotation entries to include the KMS identifier/ARN and the rotation timestamp.
- We will send a one-way NDA link via DocuSign for receiving the unredacted SOC 2; procurement will attach it to PROC-4721.

Please proceed and send the redacted SOC 2 now so our legal team can start review.

Thanks,
Alice

On Mon, May 25, 2026 at 10:03 AM Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com> wrote:

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: MercyHealth evidence extraction plan

Jonas —

Putting together the extraction plan and assigning owners:

- Authn logs: I will run the extraction job against the auth-ingest BigQuery cluster. Output CSV schema: timestamp,event_type,outcome,source_ip,user_hash,session_id. I’ll salt hashes with the HMAC-SHA256 salt when MercyHealth provides it via the DocuSign NDA. Estimated extraction time: 6 hours (job scheduled for 2026-05-31 02:00 UTC).

- MFA rotation sample: Security will produce mfa_rotation_sample_2026-04.csv (columns: timestamp,user_hash,method,event) and we will include a short README describing the hashing approach.

- Privileged access review: Laura will compile the access review summary and the last rotation/certification artifacts into a single PDF.

- Keystore rotation entries: I’ll pull rotation events from KMS logs and include the KMS ARN, rotation timestamp, and the key alias.
Deliverables and timing: evidence_matrix_mercyhealth.xlsx (tracking) + redwood_soc2_type_ii_2025_redacted.pdf (sent) by 2026-05-27; remaining CSVs and privileged access PDF by 2026-06-02. We will mark any items that require on-site/cloud-account proofs as "NDA-only."
Action items for security ops: please confirm you can run the extraction job on 2026-05-31 and that the CSVs will be stored in the secure S3 bucket for pickup (s3://redwood-evidence/mercyhealth/PROC-4721). I’ll attach the evidence matrix to the ticket and share the DocuSign link with MercyHealth.
Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: evidence_matrix_mercyhealth.xlsx (xlsx), mfa_rotation_sample_2026-04.csv (csv)
